author: Zoe Lu
transcript: this, this to this, this to this, and this to this with a simple command inside of chatgbt. Codex, chatgbt's coding tool edited this entire video. I didn't have to go into edits. I didn't have to go into cap cut. This was ready to post. Let me explain exactly what I did to make this happen. First, I built a really robust style guide. It was a document of everything I personally do in my videos. I use certain fonts, certain animations. I use certain noises and sound effects. I cut out certain blank moments that are over a certain amount of seconds. All of this went into a list of rules that I inputted into chatgbt's codex to get started. Second, I trained codex on how to actually edit. I did this through uploading Hey, Jen's hyper frame skills. Basically, it's a package of skills that teach codex how to think about animations, motion graphics, cutting, editing. It's a faster way to get codex editing at a higher quality. Third, you actually go in and edit your first video. You're going to drop the raw footage into codex. You're going to give a description of what you want to see in this output. You're going to want to make sure that if you're referring to any style guides, it's either included or that codex has access to that document. Usually I'm word vomiting through pressing the microphone to give it all the context it needs for that video. And then it's going to give you the first draft. It's going to take multiple drafts to get the video that you want.
title: ChatGPT Codex Edited This Entire Reel
one_liner: A creator used ChatGPT's Codex tool to fully edit a video reel with a style guide and skill uploads.
key_points: Build a style guide documenting your fonts, animations, sound effects, and cut rules to feed into Codex
Upload a skills package (e.g. Hey Jen's Hyper Frame) to train Codex on editing, motion, and cutting logic
Drop raw footage into Codex with a clear brief and style guide reference, then iterate through multiple drafts
The result is a reusable editing process that matches your personal style without manual editing software
